actions.reason: The K8_C0006|K8_C0008 boundary is the weakest and most merge-compatible in the partition. Structural diagnostics show only moderate agreement with an independent two-way partition (ARI 0.506), a modest within-versus-between affinity contrast (0.442 vs 0.178), a relatively high normalized-cut cost (0.635) indicating substantial cross-boundary connectivity, and a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.539 vs secondary 0.262), which is merge-compatible and must not be read as preserving two units. Affinity geometry is modality-discordant: only WXS separates the pair (0.40) while CT (0.01), RNA (-0.03, majority-negative 0.73), and WSI (-0.003) show essentially no separation. The two sets' RNA phenotypes are not mutually exclusive (K8_C0006 metabolic-suppression plus Wnt/mitotic-spindle up-regulation; K8_C0008 proliferative-up with immune-down), so the union is consistent with a single unit. This is a provisional comparative revision; the merged set must re-establish its own identity and independence.
